description: Full record for one cluster returned by another tool: summary, timeline, the underlying articles with their source URLs, extracted entities and CVEs. Call this for the 1-3 clusters that matter before answering in depth. `identifier` is the cluster id, its 8-character short id, or the slug from a threatcluster.io/cluster/... URL. Set `include_iocs` to also fetch the cluster's validated indicators (+1 credit). 1 credit (2 with IOCs).

include_iocs.description: also return validated IOCs (domains, IPs, hashes, URLs) for the cluster
